name: Mpox
value: Clade Ib community spread in 9 European states
summary: WHO lists clade Ib community transmission in nine European countries; no new mpox emergency declared
state: WHO's situation report of 14 Sep lists community transmission of clade Ib in Czechia, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, the Netherlands, Portugal, Switzerland and the UK, with Chile and Hungary reporting their first clade Ib cases; African cases were broadly stable at about 200 a week (WHO). Searches on 14 Nov found no newer WHO report and no new emergency of international concern. Clade I spread outside Africa keeps this at Watch.
for_you: Risk to the general public is low; spread is mainly through close and sexual contact. UKHSA keeps a list of clade I affected countries, and NHS guidance covers symptoms and vaccine eligibility.
rubric_hit: Clade Ib spreading outside Africa (community transmission in 9 European countries) = Watch line

sources.title: WHO — Multi-country outbreak of mpox, external situation report 69

why: Clade I mpox is more severe and has spread beyond Central Africa.
drivers: Case growth, vaccine access, travel-linked spread.
